Package Model.Repository

Class ClientRepository

java.lang.Object
Model.Repository.ClientRepository
public class ClientRepository extends Object
Repository for managing Client entities in Firestore and handling Firebase Authentication (including Google Sign-In).

  • Method Details

    • insertClient

      public com.google.android.gms.tasks.Task<Client> insertClient(String username, String password, Phone phone, String email, String firstName, String lastName, Address address, Gender gender)
      Registers a new client: checks availability, creates a Firebase Auth user, and writes the client record to Firestore.
      Parameters:
      username - desired unique username
      password - desired password
      phone - client's phone number
      email - client's email (used for Auth)
      firstName - client's first name
      lastName - client's last name
      address - client's address
      gender - client's gender
      Returns:
      a Task completing with the new Client on success, or failing with:
      • IllegalArgumentException if username/email taken;
      • any FirebaseAuth or Firestore exception otherwise.

    • updateClientByID

      public com.google.android.gms.tasks.Task<Boolean> updateClientByID(Client client)
      Updates all fields of an existing Client document (except auth fields).
      Parameters:
      client - the client to update (must have a valid id)
      Returns:
      a Task completing with true if the set succeeded, false otherwise

    • deleteClientByID

      public com.google.android.gms.tasks.Task<Boolean> deleteClientByID(Client client)
      Deletes the currently authenticated client from Firestore and Firebase Auth.
      Parameters:
      client - the client to delete (id must match current user)
      Returns:
      a Task completing with true if deletion succeeded
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if no user signed in
      IllegalArgumentException - if signed-in user does not match client id

    • checkLogin

      public com.google.android.gms.tasks.Task<Client> checkLogin(String username, String password)
      Authenticates a client by username/password. First fetches the Firestore record (to get the email), then signs in via FirebaseAuth.
      Parameters:
      username - the client's username
      password - the client's password
      Returns:
      a Task completing with the authenticated Client, or failing with:
      • NoSuchElementException if no such username;
      • SecurityException if UID mismatch;
      • any Firebase exception otherwise.

    • getClientByUsername

      public com.google.android.gms.tasks.Task<Client> getClientByUsername(String username)
      Looks up a client by their unique username.
      Parameters:
      username - the username to query
      Returns:
      a Task completing with the found Client, or failing with IllegalArgumentException if not found, or any Firestore exception.

    • handleGoogleAuthWithFirebase

      public com.google.android.gms.tasks.Task<Client> handleGoogleAuthWithFirebase(String idTokenForFirebase, String accessTokenForPeopleApi, @Nullable String serverAuthCode)
      Signs in to Firebase using a Google ID token, then fetches profile info from Google People API to create or update the Client record.
      Parameters:
      idTokenForFirebase - Google ID Token for Firebase Auth
      accessTokenForPeopleApi - OAuth2 access token for People API
      serverAuthCode - optional server auth code (may be null)
      Returns:
      a Task completing with the up-to-date Client or failing with any auth/IO/JSON exception encountered.
